cardEffects:
[On Play] You may play 2 level 4 or lower Digimon cards with the [Bagra Army] trait from your trash without paying their memory costs. All Digimon played by this effect gain ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) until the end of your opponent's turn.
[Opponent's Turn] When an effect would trash one of your other Digimon's digivolution cards, you may trash this Digimon's digivolution cards with that effect instead.
name: Tactimon

rulings.question: Does this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect activate when an opponent's effect trashes one of my Digimon's digivolution cards?

rulings.answer: Yes, you can. If you do, trash as many of this card's digivolution cards as possible.
rulings.question: A "trash 2 digivolution cards" effect activates on 1 of my Digimon with 2 or more digivolution cards when this Digimon has only 1 digivolution card. Can I activate this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect?

rulings.answer: Yes, you can. If you do, trash the total number of digivolution cards that would have been trashed from each of the Digimon that you replaced with this Digimon.
rulings.question: If a "trash 1 digivolution card" effect activates on 2 of my Digimon, can I activate this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect and trash just this Digimon's digivolution cards?

rulings.answer: Trash 2 cards. If this card has 1 or fewer digivolution cards, trash as many as possible.
rulings.question: If a "Trash 2 digivolution cards" effect activates on 1 of my Digimon with only 1 digivolution card, can I activate this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect and trash this Digimon's digivolution cards, and if so, how many do I trash?

rulings.answer: Yes, you can. If you do while this Digimon has no digivolution cards, digivolution cards will not be trashed. If there are effects that activate when digivolution cards are trashed, such as "By trashing a digivolution card," the effect will not activate because digivolution cards were not trashed.
rulings.question: A "trash digivolution cards" effect targets one of my Digimon when this Digimon has 0 digivolution cards. Can I activate this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect?

rulings.answer: Yes, it is. If you can trash the number of digivolution cards specified by the effect from this Digimon, your Digimon with 0 digivolution cards can indeed activate such an effect.
rulings.question: Is it possible for one of my Digimon with 0 digivolution cards to activate an effect that reads "By trashing X of this Digimon's digivolution cards" by way of activating this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect and trashing those cards from this Digimon?

rulings.answer: Yes, you can. If you trash 1 digivolution card for each of your Digimon, you do not have to trash your other Digimon's digivolution cards.
rulings.question: My opponent activates a "Trash the bottom digivolution card of all of your opponent's Digimon" effect. Can I use this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect to trash just this 1 Digimon's digivolution cards without trashing my other Digimon's digivolution cards?
